incidents.name: TokenHolder executes caller-supplied selling code
incidents.notes: The borrower-operations sell() path forwards caller-supplied `sellingCode` calldata into the TokenHolder contract without validating it, so the attacker passed privilegedLoan(WBNB, 20 ether) and had 20 WBNB paid out to itself.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x8c7f34436C0037742AeCf047e06fD4B27Ad01117 created 2025-10-07T12:09:17Z by 0x8432cd30c4d72ee793399e274c482223dca2bf9e, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x3fee6d8aaea76d06cf1ebeaf6b186af215f14088; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 20 WBNB x $1288.836162/BNB at the incident timestamp 1759891887 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $25,777.

onchain review: victim re-anchored from implementation 0x8c7f34436C0037742AeCf047e06fD4B27Ad01117 to the proxy the protocol runs at, 0x616b36265759517af14300ba1dd20762241a3828, which holds that implementation in its EIP-1967 slot and emits the exploit transaction's logs while the implementation emits none; age measured from when the proxy started running the implementation rather than from the implementation's own deployment (52930s -> 52766s)
